attempts.attempt: P2 calibration: NSScreen frames + frames of the OTHER menu bar extras

argv: ObjC.import("AppKit"); ObjC.import("Foundation");const screens = []; const ss = $.NSScreen.screens;for (let i = 0; i < ss.count; i++) { const f = ss.objectAtIndex(i).frame; screens.push({x: f.origin.x, y: f.origin.y, w: f.size.width, h: f.size.height}); }const se = Application("System Events"); const names = ["SimiGo", "Control Center", "SystemUIServer"];const procs = [];for (let n = 0; n < names.length; n++) { const nm = names[n]; try { const p = se.processes.byName(nm);  if (!p.exists()) { procs.push({name: nm, exists: false}); continue; }  const rec = {name: nm, exists: true, bars: p.menuBars.length, extras: []};  for (let b = 0; b < rec.bars; b++) { const bar = p.menuBars[b]; const cnt = bar.menuBarItems.length;   for (let i = 0; i < cnt; i++) { const it = bar.menuBarItems[i];    const e = {bar: b, i: i, pos: null, size: null, desc: null};    try { e.pos = it.position(); } catch (err) {}    try { e.size = it.size(); } catch (err) {}    try { e.desc = String(it.description()); } catch (err) {}    rec.extras.push(e); } }  procs.push(rec); } catch (e) { procs.push({name: nm, error: String(e)}); } }JSON.stringify({screens: screens, processes: procs})

attempts.attempt: P3 proper dispatch test: AXShowMenu on the app menu, then press Settings...

argv: const se = Application("System Events"); const p = se.processes.byName("SimiGo");const out = {windowsBefore: p.windows.length, showError: null, pressError: null,             pressed: null, windowsAfter: null, windowTitles: [], menusOpenAfterShow: null};try { p.menuBars[0].menuBarItems[1].actions.byName("AXShowMenu").perform(); }catch (e) { out.showError = String(e); }delay(1.2);try { out.menusOpenAfterShow = p.menuBars[0].menuBarItems[1].menus.length; } catch (e) {}try { const items = p.menuBars[0].menuBarItems[1].menus[0].menuItems(); for (let i = 0; i < items.length; i++) { const t = String(items[i].title());  if (t.indexOf("Settings") >= 0) { items[i].actions[0].perform(); out.pressed = t; } } }catch (e) { out.pressError = String(e); }delay(2.5);out.windowsAfter = p.windows.length;for (let i = 0; i < out.windowsAfter; i++) { try { out.windowTitles.push(String(p.windows[i].name())); } catch (e) { out.windowTitles.push("ERR"); } }JSON.stringify(out)
